verdict.rationale: Capacities documents templates that prefill an object's properties and blocks. This covers reusable templates applied when creating recurring kinds of notes. Nothing in the evidence shows dynamic variables such as date or title being substituted into a template, and that is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: template variables (date/title placeholders), detail on how templates are applied automatically per object type or for daily notes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
